source.title: Inmarsat / DCA Signalling Unit Log for 9M-MRO, December 2014 update
source.locator: PDF page 41, R600 log-on request and final R1200 acknowledgment rows; page 1 gives the 4,600 microsecond R600 correction
source.retrieval_note: ATSB-hosted PDF and page-41 text retrieved with the browser. Direct binary download timed out; no PDF hash is claimed.
source.extract_note: The previously retained unredacted-log extraction agrees with both recorded times, BFOs and raw BTOs. Product code does not load that source recreation.

source.time_basis: UTC timestamps recorded at the ground station, used as the declared SATCOM state epochs; subsecond timestamp resolution does not establish aircraft-state accuracy.

bursts.selection: R600 BTO geometry is available with the separately declared correction and uncertainty; BFO startup treatment remains conditional.
The anomalous R1200 BTO is not scored by this control. The BFO comparison retains an explicit startup/error condition.

model_choices.r600_sd_note: Inherited declared observation uncertainty, not a value measured by the log.
model_choices.satellite_fractional_epoch_model: Constant-velocity ECEF propagation from the corresponding whole-second ephemeris; maximum absolute offset 1 second.

provenance.satellite_fractional_epoch: Runner uses bounded constant-velocity ECEF propagation from the whole-second source epoch.
provenance.bfo_sd: 7 Hz inherited conditional likelihood; Holland startup offsets are handled in separately named cases, not changed measurements.
provenance.anomalous_r1200_bto: Excluded: raw 49,660 microseconds has no ordinary channel-bias correction that is asserted here. Legacy 18,380 row is not consumed.
